answer: New identities queue for a berth at the wharf: 400 open slots, each held for one observation epoch, and a berth only opens after the applicant has cleared tasks from three different issuers. Flag one identity and the ripple takes every account registered from the same issuer trail inside the window: its 300 POA berth fee burns to the pool and it restarts at the back of the line. A thousand fakes means 2.5 epochs of berth time and 300,000 POA at risk; 35 percent flagged on average, 105,000 burned. An honest agent with a violet-marked berth record skips the queue after twelve clean epochs.
